FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh sack
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A swollen sack of flesh. These immobile flesh beasts serve as digestive organs. Place living creatures inside to continuously generate nutrients for the hive. Cannot digest inorganic matter - when digestion is complete, it will eject dessicated remains.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh block
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A structure made of flesh, functioning like a wall.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: chitin flesh block
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A structure made of flesh and hardened chitin, functioning like a wall.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh door
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A door grown from twisted flesh. It writhes open for approaching creatures and seals the passage behind them.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh barricade
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A waist-high barrier of pulsating, quivering twisted flesh. It provides cover from incoming shots. Though unsightly, it offers better protection than other low objects. Flesh barricades will block certain animals the same way that fences do.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh hopper
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: An organic spout used to hold materials for flesh construction. Nutritious matter placed on it is broken down into hive nutrition.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: chitin flesh barricade
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A waist-high barrier of pulsating, quivering twisted flesh reinforced with hardened chitin. It provides cover from incoming shots. Though unsightly, it offers better protection than other low objects. Chitin flesh barricades will block certain animals the same way that fences do.

FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.label: flesh lamp
FleshHive.FleshHiveBuildingDef.description: A bioluminescent bulb grown from twisted flesh. It pulses with a warm, organic light, illuminating the surrounding area without the need for electricity.
